facts.fact: 副歌开题：意识分装 GHOST/BODY 两声部——「Tell me why I’m not dead」；healer 查无伤可配衣损——Jas 短暂失联后归来：「You healed yourself...Just as you healed Rian from the brink of death」。
facts.anchor: THE GHOST: I should be dead.

facts.fact: 洗浴：水转粉转黑（她的血、父亲的血）——她死抱血水盆不放——「Don't let me be separated from any part of him」。
facts.anchor: This is all I have left.

facts.fact: parlor 集合：书墙+astrolabe（金环构出 Cosmic Scale 形状）；imperators 摘面具；Dante 仍镣铐但口枷已除；报名仪式（Dante 迟疑后才认 heir）。
tether 视界：暖红/烁金/最深的蓝自众人身体开花——猫摇篮式的连接——「She was not alone」——指尖的霜化了。
识破：Nikolas 摇头否认知情——她穿透恍惚看清：「This wasn't a ploy to seek forgiveness from his god. This was a scheme to get them close enough to kill Phos.」；Julian/Dante 请随、Angelica 自请留守会见 Kaspan 家属。
facts.anchor: This was a scheme to get them close enough to kill Phos.

facts.fact: Edwin 入队：自荐 wasteland trekker——Nikolas 立刻应下（真实动机：把矛的秘密带出城）——「But no soldiers. They would only be targets for Tae… for the Sunslayer.」
facts.anchor: And take the secret of the Sunbringer Spear out of the city with them.

facts.fact: 通灵交易：Varrick 问 Vakara 死术——她答「Necromancy. Yes.」——条件：见被收缴的 Samhara（要问 Val fulcrum 是物体还是灵魂）——「Very well. But it will not be returned to you.」
自证实验：她沉入生死之谷种下一粒棘种——咳血满地化花瓣——「To prove that it's real」——GHOST 末句「To prove that I cannot die」。
facts.anchor: To prove that I cannot die.
